Facts: From 2010-2012, defendant Wang introduced others to issue false VAT special invoices for a company, total 46 invoices, tax amount 180,828.63 RMB, used for tax deduction, causing state tax loss. Also seized many forged invoices (machine printed, ordinary). He confessed. The company refunded tax.
